name: Nihongo Master v1.1.7 - Fuji Speedway Racing Circuit
changelog: v1.1.7: Overhauled Stage 10 (Fuji Speedway) in both Hiragana Arcade and Katakana Arcade into an authentic FIA Grand Prix racing circuit with multi-tier stadium grandstands, 84 cheering fans with waving flags and sparkling camera flashes, full pit lane complex with team garages and mechanics holding pit boards, Dunlop chicane with 150m/100m/50m brake marker boards, corner runoff tire walls in team color bands, trackside safety catch fences with cheering crowds, corner marshal posts with waving green/yellow flags, overhead start lights gantry and enclosed sponsor footbridges, dark formula asphalt with rubbered-in racing groove, and sweeping floodlight searchlights.
